svg.title: 带动量 Muon：LR 与 ELR

cc:Work.dc:title: 带动量 Muon：LR 与 ELR
cc:Work.dc:description: Prescribed linear external LR and a heuristic ELR curve for momentum Muon, with constant update RMS and exponentially growing weight squared RMS; c0=0.9, kappa=5. Decay phase after warmup, each curve normalized to its own initial value. Not a proof of optimal LR or an empirical fit. All axes linear.
